description: This file defines an immutable builder class for creating instances of JsonParseOptions, allowing configuration of URL decoding options.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonParseOptionsBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, final class that implements a builder pattern for JsonParseOptions with options to enable or disable URL decoding.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the builder.

methods.name: withUrlDecoding
methods.description: Configures the builder to enable URL decoding.

methods.name: withoutUrlDecoding
methods.description: Configures the builder to disable URL decoding.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an immutable JsonParseOptions object based on the current builder configuration.
